sections.label: Semakau landfill lifespan and plastics
sections.summary: Semakau Landfill will run out of space by 2035, so the Ministry is developing waste-reduction measures, and an NEA study found plastic alternatives also have environmental impact.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our only landfill at Semakau will run out of space by 2035 based on our current waste disposal trends.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To prolong the lifespan of Semakau Landfill, my Ministry has been developing measures that address the entire waste value chain and across different waste streams by encouraging businesses and producers to reduce waste and recycle, engaging and partnering the public and private sector and supporting research and development (R&D).

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding single-use plastics, a recent NEA life-cycle assessment study found that available alternatives to plastics, including biodegradable bags, also have an environmental impact.

sections.label: Packaging reporting and producer responsibility
sections.summary: Mandatory packaging data reporting and reduction plans move to 2020, an Extended Producer Responsibility framework is being studied, and disposables are disallowed in new hawker centres for dine-ins.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To encourage businesses to minimise their contribution to plastic waste, my Ministry recently announced that the implementation of mandatory reporting of packaging data and packaging reduction plans will be brought forward by one year, to 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are also studying the feasibility of implementing an Extended Producer Responsibility framework for certain single-use packaging and plastics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have already taken the lead by disallowing the use of disposables in our new hawker centres for dine-ins.

sections.label: Disbursements, diverted waste, packaging award
sections.summary: About $1.36 million has been disbursed, 11,000 tonnes of waste diverted from incineration plants, and Australian Fruit Juice (S) Pte Ltd received the Singapore Packaging Agreement Award.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since then, we have disbursed about $1.36 million for such projects and have diverted 11,000 tonnes of waste from the incineration plants.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There is the Singapore Packaging Agreement Award that we give out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This year, we have awarded Australian Fruit Juice (S) Pte Ltd because they have put in effort to reduce their packaging waste like reducing the packaging material for their 2-litre bottles.

sections.label: SEC survey on plastic bag reuse
sections.summary: An SEC study found two-thirds of respondents who take single-use plastic bags from supermarkets say they use them to bag and dispose of garbage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In Singapore, for instance, the Singapore Environment Council (SEC) study, the recent survey, has shown that two-thirds of the respondents who take single-use plastic bags from supermarkets say that they use these bags to bag and dispose their garbage.

sections.label: Bringing forward mandatory packaging reporting
sections.summary: The government will not hesitate to implement legislation and policies where appropriate, and is bringing forward mandatory packaging waste reporting and waste reduction plans, including for plastics, by a year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have noted, we will not hesitate to implement legislation and policies where they are appropriate.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, we are bringing forward our mandatory packaging waste reporting and waste reduction plans, including for plastics, by a year.

sections.label: No charge on single-use plastics
sections.summary: Currently, there is no plan to implement a charge on single-use plastics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Currently, we do not plan to implement a charge on single-use plastics.
